integrity: The proof is symbolic. The bundled checker replays the finite reductions and separately performs a bounded corroborative scan; no finite scan is used as an infinite proof.
limitations: The theorem concerns only the exponent pattern \(p^{2a}q\) with the second prime to the first power; it does not classify all two-prime bi-unitary harmonic numbers.
title: Rigidity in a two-prime bi-unitary harmonic family
